confidence_notes: Leh food and drink estimates are informed by [SoloSquare](https://solosquare.app/cost-of-living/leh) and a [Leh food guide](https://discoverwithdheeraj.com/list-of-good-restaurants-in-leh-ladakh-restaurant-reviews/), with [regional Numbeo data](https://www.numbeo.com/cost-of-living/admin1Unit?country=India&unit=Himachal+Pradesh) as a cross-check. Local data is limited, and the beer evidence is mostly for beer served in bars rather than specifically draft beer. Cocktail and wine prices are estimated relative to beer and are especially uncertain. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates for the July peak season.
comparable_city_reasoning: Himachal Pradesh mountain tourist towns such as Manali provide a regional basis, adjusted for Leh's remoteness and summer tourism demand.
